context: A ~20 minute sales discovery call with Globex, a US logistics company. Marco and Dana sell 'Raven', a meeting-memory product. Tara is the prospect. This is a DIFFERENT prospect from Acme and Northwind, but Marco runs it too — so questions about 'Marco's commitments' or 'the sales call' must not conflate this with the Acme or Northwind calls.

participants.name: Marco
participants.role: account executive at Raven, runs the call

participants.name: Tara
participants.role: head of operations at Globex, the prospect

mustInclude: Globex currently uses Fireflies for transcription, and Tara finds it noisy and hard to search.
Globex runs a lot of cross-team logistics standups that nobody can later reconstruct.
Globex's main ask is a Slack integration that pushes action items into their ops channel.
Dana shows how Raven extracts action items with owners and due dates.
Tara's budget for tooling this year is about fifteen thousand dollars.
Compliance concern: Globex requires a self-hosted / on-prem deployment, they cannot use a multi-tenant cloud.
Decision: Globex agrees to a 1-week trial with 5 seats.
Action item: Marco will send the trial invite by Friday.
Action item: Dana will check whether a self-hosted deployment is possible and report back.
